content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Sovereign Commerce is a digital commerce infrastructure that empowers digital creators to build, deploy, and scale their own online stores, complete with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This architecture, built on Cloudflare Workers, GitHub Pages, and NOWPayments, allows creators to process payments directly to their wallets, eliminating the need for intermediaries like Stripe or PayPal. By leveraging Solana payments, creators can sell digital products, such as ebooks and courses, while retaining full control over their business and avoiding the fees associated with traditional payment processors.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The Sovereign Commerce architecture is built on a stack of free and open-source tools, including Cloudflare Workers, GitHub Pages, and NOWPayments. Cloudflare Workers handle the backend logic, while GitHub Pages hosts the store, and NOWPayments integrates crypto payment processing. This stack enables creators to build, deploy, and scale their online stores quickly and cost-effectively, without relying on traditional payment processors. By integrating Solana payments, creators can accept various cryptocurrencies, including USDT and Bitcoin, and process payments directly to their wallets.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This sovereign commerce solution is designed for digital creators who want to build and deploy their own online stores, without relying on third-party payment processors like Stripe or PayPal. These creators, often found in regions with restricted payment gateways, such as Zimbabwe, Ghana, and Kenya, face significant barriers to selling digital products online. By providing a sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators can break free from these limitations and build their own businesses, on their own terms.
Creators can sell digital products online without relying on Stripe or PayPal by leveraging Solana payments and a sovereign commerce infrastructure.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The Sovereign Commerce architecture is comprised of several key components, including Cloudflare Workers, GitHub Pages, NOWPayments, and Solana. Cloudflare Workers handle the backend logic, while GitHub Pages hosts the store. NOWPayments integrates crypto payment processing, enabling creators to accept various cryptocurrencies and process payments directly to their wallets. Solana, as the payment processor, enables fast and secure transactions, with low fees and no intermediaries.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign commerce store today, creators can start by purchasing the Complete Builder Kit, which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, everything needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. With this kit, creators can build their stores on Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, and integrate Solana payments for fast and secure transactions. By following the step-by-step instructions and leveraging the kit's resources, creators can deploy their stores in no time.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The most important question a reader would ask is: How can I sell digital products online without relying on Stripe or PayPal? The answer is: By using Solana payments and a sovereign commerce infrastructure, such as the one provided by COREMERCH, you can build and deploy your own online store, process payments directly to your wallets, and avoid the fees associated with traditional payment processors.

With this kit, creators can access all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, and deploy their stores on Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments. By leveraging this kit, creators can build and deploy their stores faster and more efficiently, and take advantage of the low fees and high security offered by Solana payments. To shop for additional resources, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I integrate Solana payments with my store?

To integrate Solana payments with your store, you'll need to set up a NOWPayments account and configure the payment processor on your store's backend. This typically involves copying and pasting a code snippet from NOWPayments into your store's codebase. Once set up, Solana payments will be available for use on your store.
Can I use Solana payments with other cryptocurrencies?

Yes, NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including USDT and Bitcoin. By leveraging Solana payments, creators can accept various cryptocurrencies and process payments directly to their wallets.
How do I configure my store's settings for Solana payments?

To configure your store's settings for Solana payments, you'll need to set up a NOWPayments account and configure the payment processor on your store's backend. This typically involves setting up the payment processor's API keys and configuring the payment methods available on your store.
Can I use Solana payments with my existing store?

Yes, creators can integrate Solana payments with their existing stores by setting up a NOWPayments account and configuring the payment processor on their store's backend. This typically involves copying and pasting a code snippet from NOWPayments into their store's codebase.
How do I process refunds with Solana payments?

To process refunds with Solana payments, creators will need to set up a NOWPayments account and configure the payment processor on their store's backend. This typically involves setting up the payment processor's API keys and configuring the refund methods available on their store.
